frequency_question: What proportion of major fiscal policy proposals tabled before national tax councils are fully approved and notified within a tight 63-day calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items concerning new service tax rates or exemptions submitted to the national fiscal council; excludes routine administrative clarifications or retrospective amendments.

known_gaps: Excludes items deferred due to lack of consensus, aligning with the assumption of full cooperation.
skeleton: 6 historical major policy decisions analyzed for end-to-end procedural completion within 60 days of formal proposal inclusion.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 observed major expedited decisions where administrative machinery was fully aligned.
validity_reason: Procedural rules and committee voting/notification structures for national fiscal bodies remain stable over multi-year horizons.
